claim_scope: Consumed-development provider replication. It tests whether the same frozen algorithmic contrast is observable when the same DeepSeek-V4-Pro model is served directly by DeepSeek. It is not held-out, final-test, leaderboard, or a replacement for the OpenRouter qualification.

frozen_comparison.episode_order: Identical positions, case blocks, and condition order to the original frozen schedule.

frozen_provider_change.model_identity_rule: The OpenRouter slug deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro and DeepSeek direct ID deepseek-v4-pro identify DeepSeek V4 Pro. Serving provider remains an explicit experimental factor.
frozen_provider_change.pricing_policy: Official direct prices are denominated in CNY. No exchange-rate conversion is frozen, so estimated_cost_usd is disabled with zero rates; tokens, requests, environments, commands, and wall-clock remain the resource outcomes.

hypothesis.primary: Under direct serving of the same model, operation-contract-v1 does not reduce paired Pass@1 relative to the frozen fresh control.
hypothesis.secondary: The exact-ID and operation-feasibility failure signatures observed before OpenRouter closure either replicate or disappear under a different serving provider.

provider_gate.proceed_rule: All three repository-free responses finish normally and parse into valid operation-contract candidates with no request or policy error.
